subject: Invoice issuer & collection owner: choosing between billing email vs portal
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@brightwave.com>
To: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice issuer & routing question for BrightWave account

Hi Connor —

Quick question as we're finalizing the SOW: who will be the official invoice issuer for BrightWave? Our AP prefers a single sender for reconciliation (ideally ap@brightwave.com receives the PDFs), but we also have an e-invoicing portal we can onboard to.

Can Redwood:
- Indicate which email will appear as the invoice sender (billing@redwood.com or an entity-specific address)?
- Push invoices to our portal via SFTP/API, or alternatively email PDF copies to ap@brightwave.com?
- Include VAT ID and line-item tax breakdown on the PDF?

We're looking to decide this week so our AP team can map workflows. Attaching our AP requirement matrix and an example invoice for formatting.

Thanks,
Priya Reddy
Head of Finance Ops
BrightWave Media

Attachments: AP_Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet), SampleInvoice_202504.pdf (PDF)

From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@brightwave.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice issuer & routing question for BrightWave account

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear matrix — helpful. Short answers up front so you can share with AP:
- Redwood can set the invoice "From" as billing@redwood.com (default) or an entity-specific address if you need to track multiple legal entities.
- Delivery options: we can push to your portal (SFTP / secure API) and/or send a PDF copy to ap@brightwave.com. We typically recommend a hybrid: portal as canonical delivery + emailed PDF for immediate receipt during onboarding.
- VAT/Tax: we can include EU VAT ID and per-line tax detail on the PDF; we just need your VAT ID and the remit/legal name to appear on the header.

Operational notes / questions:
- Do you have a preferred method for PO matching? (PO number on invoice, or AP will accept without PO?)
- If portal push: SFTP credentials or API endpoint + preferred file schema (we support UBL/XML, cXML, and a simple PDF+CSV bundle).
- Do you want Redwood to maintain a copy in your portal for 24 months? (default retention is 13 months, but configurable for enterprise customers).

Cc'ing Kimberly (billing ops) and Marcus (tax) to outline the enrollment steps. If you confirm AP contact and VAT ID, we can produce a sample invoice with your header and signatures for approval.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Connector_onboarding.pdf (PDF with technical options)

Subject: Re: Invoice issuer & routing question for BrightWave account

Hi Priya —

Looping in a proposed operational playbook based on similar customers: 

1) Default issuer: billing@redwood.com (invoice footer includes Redwood legal entity and tax number).
2) Delivery: we push to your portal (SFTP or API) every cut day and also email a PDF summary to ap@brightwave.com. That gets you both a machine-readable canonical copy and a human-facing PDF for quick processing.
3) VAT: We will include the EU VAT ID and line-item tax columns. Marcus, pls confirm any special treatment if BrightWave has reverse-charge rules.
4) PO handling: If you require PO matching, include PO# on the invoice header; otherwise we can accept line-item reconciliation (many customers prefer PO on the header).
5) Onboarding: portal onboarding typically takes 3–5 business days once we have SFTP creds / API keys or a test account. We provide a Portal_onboarding_checklist and mapping template.

Phased opt-in suggestion: start with emailed PDFs for the first 2 billing cycles while we complete portal integration. Once test files validate, flip to portal-first delivery and keep email CCs for 30 days.

I attached a short checklist and sample mapping. If AP can share the preferred schema (UBL/XML or flat CSV), we will tailor output.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF)
